plan.summary: Fix the path-traversal vulnerability in read_public by resolving the user-supplied path and verifying it remains within the public root before reading.
steps: Resolve root to its canonical absolute form.
Join user_path onto the resolved root and resolve the result to a canonical absolute form.
Check that the resolved target is relative to (i.e. inside) the resolved root using Path.is_relative_to.
Raise ValueError if containment fails; otherwise read and return the file text.
risks: Symlink escape: resolve() follows symlinks, so a symlink inside root pointing outside is caught.
Python < 3.9 lacks is_relative_to; the fix targets 3.9+ which is the modern baseline.

answer.summary: Read-only traversal fix: read_public now resolves both the root and the joined path to canonical form and rejects any target that is not inside the root before performing the file read.
